facts.fact: According to Livemint, over 150 million Americans watch YouTube on connected TV screens each month, which the source says is more than 40% of the U.S. population.
facts.quote: Over 150 million Americans now watch YouTube on connected TV screens each month, representing more than 40% of the U.S. population, according to Livemint.

facts.fact: According to Nielsen, YouTube captured 11.6% of total TV viewing time in February 2025.
facts.quote: capturing 11.6% of total TV viewing in February 2025 according to Nielsen

facts.fact: TV screens accounted for 36% of total YouTube viewer hours in the U.S. during the first half of 2025.
facts.quote: TV screens became the primary device for YouTube consumption in the U.S. during the first half of 2025, accounting for 36% of total viewer hours.

facts.fact: The vendor states that average YouTube session length on CTV exceeds 45 minutes, compared with approximately 20 minutes on mobile devices (no source cited).
facts.quote: Average session length on CTV exceeds 45 minutes, compared to approximately 20 minutes on mobile devices.

facts.fact: The vendor states that YouTube CTV peak viewership occurs between 7 PM and 11 PM local time.
facts.quote: peak viewership between 7 PM and 11 PM local time

facts.fact: The vendor reports that adults aged 18-34 account for approximately 15% of TV time on YouTube, the highest share among age groups.
facts.quote: Adults 18-34:**Approximately 15% of TV time on YouTube (highest share among age groups)

facts.fact: The vendor reports that adults aged 35-49 account for approximately 11% of TV time on YouTube.
facts.quote: Adults 35-49:**Approximately 11% of TV time on YouTube

facts.fact: The vendor reports that adults aged 50-64 account for approximately 7% of TV time on YouTube.
facts.quote: Adults 50-64:**Approximately 7% of TV time on YouTube

facts.fact: The vendor reports that adults aged 65+ account for approximately 4% of TV time on YouTube, the lowest share among age groups.
facts.quote: Adults 65+:**Approximately 4% of TV time on YouTube (lowest share)

facts.fact: Adwave states that advertisers can reach CTV audiences on its aggregated streaming inventory with budgets starting as low as $30 a day.
facts.quote: allowing advertisers to reach CTV audiences with budgets starting as low as $30 a day.

facts.fact: The page's FAQ says small businesses can reach YouTube CTV viewers through programmatic platforms with budgets starting as low as $50, which conflicts with the $30-per-day figure given elsewhere on the page.
facts.quote: with budgets starting as low as $50.

facts.fact: The page states that over 150 million Americans watch YouTube on connected TV screens each month, which it says is approximately 40% of the U.S. population; the supporting-data list attributes the 150+ million figure to Livemint.
facts.quote: Over 150 million Americans watch YouTube on connected TV screens each month, representing approximately 40% of the U.S. population.

facts.fact: According to Nielsen as cited on the page, YouTube accounted for 11.6% of total TV viewing share in February 2025.
facts.quote: Total TV viewing share: 11.6% ([Nielsen]

facts.fact: The page says Nielsen reports Netflix at approximately 8-9% of total TV viewing, compared with YouTube at 11.6%.
facts.quote: Nielsen reports YouTube at 11.6% of total TV viewing compared to Netflix at approximately 8-9%.

facts.fact: The page states that TV screens represent 36% of total YouTube viewing hours.
facts.quote: TV screens now representing 36% of total YouTube viewing hours.

facts.fact: The page reports an average CTV session length of more than 45 minutes on YouTube.
facts.quote: Average CTV session length: 45+ minutes

facts.fact: The page reports an average mobile session length on YouTube of approximately 20 minutes.
